name: Apple M2 (base, 8- or 10-core GPU)
memory_bandwidth_basis: 100 GB/s is the figure the llama.cpp #4167 scoreboard prints for both the 8-core and 10-core GPU M2, and it is Apple's published unified-memory bandwidth for the base M2. One die, two GPU bins.
notes: Base M2 as binned in the #4167 scoreboard: 8-core and 10-core GPU, both at 100 GB/s, up to 24 GB unified memory (MacBook Air / 13-inch MacBook Pro / Mac mini, 2022-2023). M2 Pro and M2 Max already have their own records. memory_bus_bit is null; not back-computed from bandwidth.
